rubric.role_summary: Program manager for Flight and Lab operations, coordinating R&D flight work, equipment and supply-chain dependencies, and readiness for field testing and mission deployment.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Program manager for Flight and Lab operations, coordinating R&D flight work, equipment and supply-chain dependencies, and readiness for field testing and mission deployment.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 4+ years of experience in project management, program management, delivery management, technical program management, or similar roles.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience in drone/UAV operations, robotics, aerospace, or embedded systems development.
- Experience in startups or fast-scaling product companies.
- Experience with field testing, pilot programs, demo preparation, customer trials, or production-readiness processes.
- Experience working with military, government, security, or regulated customers.
- Background in engineering, product management, operations, or business analysis.
- Ability to manage the end-to-end delivery cycle from R&D prototyping to field readiness and mission deployment.
- Ability to manage resource dependencies involving equipment procurement, manufacturing coordination, and supply-chain tracking for field assets.
- Ability to work with engineering teams to bridge lab-based R&D and real-world performance.
- Ability to produce leadership and executive-level reporting on operational blockers, equipment availability, and field mission status.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Warsaw area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.
